Job Description 

 About FIS 

 We are FIS. Our technology powers the world’s economy and our teams bring innovation to life. We champion diversity to deliver the best products and solutions for our colleagues, clients and communities. If you’re ready to start learning, growing and making an impact with a career in fintech, we’d like to know: Are you FIS?
 
 
 Current and future sponsorship not available for this position 
 
 
 This position is hybrid (3 days onsite) in Illinois, Milwaukee, Atlanta & Jacksonville. 

 About the Team 

 We are the premiere digital transformation partner for financial institutions committed to the future of banking and to creating safe and personalized customer experiences that help people better manage their financial lives. 

 Our fully integrated and flexible platform is built on years of digital lending experience, enabling digital agility within months and a full suite of end-to-end consumer, small business and embedded finance solutions that fit the way people want to bank.

 FIS technology powers the world’s economy, and our teams bring innovation to life. If you are ready to start learning, growing, and making an impact with a career in fintech, we encourage you to apply.

 About the Role 

 As a Software Engineer, your day will be filled with challenges and opportunities to shape the future of financial technology. 

 You'll collaborate with a talented team of engineers and play a crucial role in developing cutting-edge solutions that drive innovation in the financial sector. 

 Your responsibilities will include developing and implementing scalable software, troubleshooting complex issues, and contributing to the overall success of our products.

 What You Will Be Doing 

 Take the lead in developing and delivering high-quality software solutions.
 Engage in full-stack development, from backend systems to user interfaces. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, UX designers, and QA engineers, to bring innovative features and products to market. Participate in agile development processes to deliver results efficiently.
 Drive exponential productivity gains in code generation, architectural design, automated testing, and rapid problem-solving.
 Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies. Contribute to the company's technological roadmap by introducing innovative ideas and solutions.
 
 What you Bring 

 3+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on SaaS or FinTech.
 A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
 Strong proficiency in Java, JavaScript and Typescript.
 Strong experience with leveraging AI-powered development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Kiro, and frontier LLMs)
 Experience with UI development using modern web application framework, RESTful API integrations, microservices.
 Experience with Jira, Confluence, and other project management tools.
 Tech Stack: ReactJs, Java, Springboot, Micronaut, Temporal, ActiveMQ, Postgres, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, Jenkins, Git
 
 What We Offer You 

 A voice in the future of fintech.
 Continuous learning and development.
 Collaborative work environment.
 Opportunities to give back.
 Competitive salary and benefits.
 

 FIS is committed to providing its employees with an exciting career opportunity and competitive compensation. The pay range for this full-time position is $79,230.00 - $134,700.00 and reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for this position based on the posted role, level, and location.

 Within the range, actual individual starting pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Any changes in work location will also impact actual individual starting pay. 

 Please consult with your recruiter about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
